agy.name: aki__agy_run
agy.title: Antigravity CLI
agy.description: Delegate a task to the local agy CLI (read-only retrieval, never judgment). Mode defaults to "plan" (read-only by mechanism). Model defaults to the newest Gemini Flash (medium) discovery tier the installed CLI reports, not a pinned id (override: agy.defaultModel in setting.json). list="models"/"capabilities" (no prompt) reads the ids, modes, effort levels and formats the installed agy accepts now. model/effort/outputFormat pass straight to agy, which validates them; a rejected value returns agy's error and the live list. Name exact paths in the prompt — agy resolves files outside cwd, so cwd is not a hard boundary. prompt is one verbatim arg, no shell quoting.

prompt.description: the task for agy; required unless list is set

list.description: read-only: return what the installed agy offers (no prompt spawned)

mode.description: agy --mode (agy validates; "plan" is read-only and the default). Modes beyond the allowlist in setting.json are refused here

model.description: agy --model (agy validates). Omitted → the discovery-tier default; use list="models" to see the ids

effort.description: agy --effort thinking budget (agy validates; use list="capabilities" for the levels)

outputFormat.description: agy --output-format (agy validates; use list="capabilities" for the formats). Use "json" when a program parses the result

cwd.description: run inside this project dir; must be under an allowed root

kiro.name: aki__kiro_read
kiro.title: Kiro CLI (read-only)
kiro.description: Delegate a read-only task to a Kiro CLI session locked to claude-sonnet-4.5. Restricted to fs_read by mechanism (--trust-tools=fs_read) — it can read files under the allowed roots but cannot write or run shell. prompt is passed straight to kiro-cli as one argument — no shell quoting, spaces/punctuation are safe as-is.

cwd.description: run inside this project dir; must be under an allowed root
